judgments.reason: The support_span is present literally in the vignette, but the immunohistochemistry profile (AR+, SOX10+, S100+, GCDFP-15+, PASD+) and the described arrangement patterns (vesicular, tubular, striated) are characteristic of a secretory or acinic cell-type carcinoma rather than invasive ductal carcinoma of no special type (NST). The span does not clinically support 'no special type' classification; it actually points toward a special type carcinoma.
